verdict.rationale: The evidence only documents C++: developers use Gazebo libraries such as gz-math, sdformat and gz-transport directly in their own C++ applications, and write custom simulator plugins. Gz-transport's socket-based message passing gives a programmatic interface to the simulator, but nothing shows official typed SDKs in other languages or that they cover the full platform surface. Missing for 10: official Python, TypeScript and Go SDKs, evidence of typed coverage of the full platform surface, independent corroboration.
